thread:
jena (design): Quick UX check on SLO slider language + guardrail affordance in the autoscale card. Two asks: make the SLO helper clearer about tradeoffs and remove color-only guardrail cues.
omar (product): agreed. We need language that signals possible cost impact but isn't scary. Also want keyboard flow tested.
kai (eng): FYI the card is in a recycled grid so minimal DOM churn is important. Tooltips should be lazy-mounted.
jena (design): suggested SLO helper: "Latency target (ms) — soft goal for request latency. If the autoscaler adds capacity to meet this, short-term costs may increase."
lucy (a11y): good. A11y notes: include aria-describedby linking the slider to the helper. Guardrail state must have a text label and pattern (not color-only). Use aria-live="polite" for state changes and debounce updates.
jenna (design): small correction to name: jena here. Also propose a tiny guardrail chip: text "Guardrail" + diagonal hatch when active. Tooltip: "Guardrail active — autoscaler prioritizes latency; additional capacity may be used."
omar (product): CTA for billing docs: "Learn how autoscale affects billing". Keep the visible copy concise; add sr-only "opens in new tab".
kai (eng): implement notes: info icon visible 18px with 44px hit area, tooltip max width 300px on mobile, show on tap/focus only, Esc dismisses. We'll avoid hover on touch.
lucy (a11y): also ensure validation errors are announced via aria-live=polite and that sliders expose aria-valuenow/min/max.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/ui-autoscale-slo-v1 -> ~10m
omar (product): please smoke test staging (keyboard, screen reader, mobile) and report back here.
